title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
description:
Given a list of intervals represented as `[start, end]`, merge every overlapping or touching interval and return the result sorted by start. Do not change the input list.

For example, `[[1, 3], [2, 4], [7, 8]]` becomes `[[1, 4], [7, 8]]`. Intervals that share an endpoint, such as `[1, 3]` and `[3, 5]`, count as touching and should merge. An empty input returns an empty list.

solution.explanation: Sort intervals by their start and scan them from left to right. Merge an interval into the last result when they overlap or touch; otherwise start a new result interval. The function creates a new list and preserves the original input.
